dtr.label: DTR

leave.label: Leave
leave.description: The Leave module handles leave requests, approvals, and leave balances.

fuel.label: Fuel
fuel.description: The Fuel module monitors fuel requests, allocations, and remaining balance for vehicles and equipment.

travel.label: EPASS
travel.description: The EPASS module manages travel orders, destinations, and approval status.

profile.label: Employees Profile
profile.description: The Employees Profile module manages employee records, positions, departments, and contact details.

it.label: IT Equipment
it.description: The IT Equipment module tracks assets, repairs, network issues, and password support.

warehouse.label: Warehouse
warehouse.description: The Warehouse module manages stock requests, inventory, materials, and supplies.

messenger.description: The Messenger module supports chats, file sharing, and call actions.

faqEntries.answer: To check your DTR, open the DTR module from the main menu. You can see your time-in, time-out, and any late or absent days. Report any wrong entry to HR right away.
phrases: how do i view my attendance
where can i see my time in and time out

faqEntries.answer: On-time means your first time-in is at or before 8:00 AM. After 8:00 AM is counted as late. If your punch is missing, please tell HR so it can be corrected.
phrases: what is the cut off time for attendance

faqEntries.answer: To request leave, open the Forms module, fill out the leave form, and submit it to your immediate supervisor for approval. HR records the approved leave in the DTR system.
phrases: how do i file a leave
how to apply for vacation leave
how to apply for sick leave
how to take a day off

faqEntries.answer: To check your leave balance, open your Employee Profile or ask HR. Your vacation, sick, and official leave balances are shown there.
phrases: how to check my leave balance
how many leave credits do i have

faqEntries.answer: To request fuel, open the Fuel module and submit a fuel request. It goes to the approver, and once approved, fuel is allocated from the cooperative supply.
phrases: how do i request fuel allocation
how to file a fuel request

faqEntries.answer: To check your fuel balance, open the Fuel module and view your allocation record. It shows your remaining liters and recent requests.
phrases: how to check my fuel balance
how much fuel do i have left

faqEntries.answer: To request an EPASS or travel order, open the EPASS module, fill in the date, destination, and purpose, choose the employees going, then save and submit for approval.
phrases: how do i make an epass
how to file a travel order
how to request a gate pass

faqEntries.answer: To check an EPASS status, open the EPASS module and look at the request. Status shows Pending or Approved. Follow up with your approver if it stays Pending.
For an IT problem such as a computer, printer, network, or password issue, open the IT Equipment or Job Order screen and file a request describing the issue, or contact the IT department directly.
phrases: how to report an it problem
how to file an it job order

faqEntries.answer: To request materials or supplies, open the Warehouse module and submit a material requisition. The warehouse officer reviews it, and approved items are released and recorded.
phrases: how do i request supplies from warehouse
how to file a material requisition

faqEntries.answer: To update your Employee Profile, open the Employees Profile module. You can update certain fields yourself; for major changes like name or position, contact HR.
phrases: how do i change my information
how to update my employee profile

faqEntries.answer: Billing handles electricity bills for member-consumers. For a bill inquiry, open the Billing module or coordinate with the billing section for the account details.
phrases: how to inquire about a bill

faqEntries.answer: SOA (Statement of Account) shows a member-consumer's account balance and charges. Open the SOA module to generate or view a statement of account.
phrases: how to generate statement of account

faqEntries.answer: Membership handles cooperative member records and applications. Open the Membership module to view or manage member-consumer information.
Messenger is the internal chat. Open the Messenger module to send one-on-one or group messages, share files, and start a voice or video call with the phone or video icons.
phrases: how to start a group chat
how to share a file in chat

faqEntries.answer: SAMELCO II is an electric cooperative serving Samar province in Eastern Visayas, Philippines. It distributes electricity to its member-consumers across its franchise area.
The SAMELCII Web System has these modules: Employees Profile, Membership, DTR, Warehouse, IT Equipment, Fuel, SOA, Billing, Forms, Messenger, Travel, Leave, and Overtime.
To generate a report, tell me the type and period, for example: generate DTR report this month, fuel report for May, or attendance for specific dates.
phrases: how do i make a report
